id: 08_Emergency Response and Safety Training Preparedness and Best Practices
title: 应急准备与应急培训
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/08_Emergency Response and Safety Training Preparedness and Best Practices.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/08_Emergency Response and Safety Training Preparedness and Best Practices/src.py

points.K1: 储存之外，还要准备应急
points.K3: 物料不同，应急需求不同
points.K5: 培训要有实效，不能只刷题
points.K8: 针对本场所、本物料培训
points.K14: 每项风险都写进书面计划
points.S4: 恶劣天气和节假日前检查

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼走廊，身旁是应急物资柜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a lab building corridor beside a closed emergency supply cabinet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲应急准备和应急培训。

shots.scene: 预案文件夹、手形、五个警示图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a blank binder, an open hand pressing a button, and a cluster of five small warning triangles. No people.
shots.narration: 有计划、练过手、认得清风险。

shots.scene: 阿杰盯着电脑做完线上安全题，一脸轻松
shots.prompt_en: The young male student smiles in front of a laptop showing a blank quiz page with a big green check mark.
shots.narration: 阿杰线上安全考试满分，觉得万事大吉。

shots.scene: 小研带他走到墙边，指着手动火灾报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the young male student to a wall and points at a red manual fire alarm call point.
shots.narration: 小研问：手动报警按钮在哪？怎么按？

shots.scene: 阿杰愣住，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student freezes with a big question mark floating above his head beside the red call point.
shots.narration: 阿杰从没亲手找过。题会做，不等于会用。

shots.section_title: 储存之外，还要准备应急
shots.scene: 欣欣站在整齐的试剂柜旁，竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a neat closed chemical storage cabinet and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 储存做得好，只是第一步。
overlay: 储存之外，还要准备应急

shots.section_title: 储存之外，还要准备应急
shots.scene: 试剂柜图标加号连到急救箱与灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: A chemical cabinet icon, a plus sign, then a first aid kit icon and a fire extinguisher icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还得为可能的紧急情况，提前做准备。

shots.section_title: 储存之外，还要准备应急
shots.scene: 实验室平面图上几个区域亮起应急设施图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple lab floor plan diagram with glowing icons of an eyewash, a safety shower and an extinguisher in certain zones. No people.
shots.narration: 重点区域要配齐应急设施。

shots.scene: 储罐图标顶上的泄压阀向上排气
shots.prompt_en: A closed storage tank icon with a relief valve on top releasing a small puff upward. No people.
shots.narration: 储存压力物料的容器，要有泄压设计。

shots.scene: 老李在通风柜旁查看排风指示
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the airflow indicator beside a fume hood, with a ventilation duct on the ceiling.
shots.narration: 工作区要能在紧急时保持通风。

shots.scene: 规范文件图标旁是说明书图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank regulation document icon beside a blank equipment manual icon. No people.
shots.narration: 具体要求按国家标准和设备说明书。

shots.section_title: 物料不同，应急需求不同
shots.scene: 三个试剂瓶图标分别连着火焰、腐蚀、毒性象形图
shots.prompt_en: Three blank bottle icons, each linked to a different hazard pictogram: flame, corrosion, skull. No people.
shots.narration: 物料不同，出事的方式也不同。
overlay: 物料不同，应急需求不同

shots.section_title: 物料不同，应急需求不同
shots.scene: 小研对照试剂清单，在应急物资柜前点数
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank checklist and counts items in an open emergency supply cabinet.
shots.narration: 逐一想好，每种物料该怎么应急。

shots.scene: 王老师在办公室打电话，桌上有培训日程表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator talks on the phone at a desk with a blank training schedule sheet.
shots.narration: 危险废物和应急岗位，有专门培训要求。

shots.scene: 阿杰向王老师咨询，王老师指向日历
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the safety administrator a question; the administrator points to a blank calendar.
shots.narration: 需要什么培训、去哪参加，先问清楚。

shots.section_title: 培训要有实效，不能只刷题
shots.scene: 笔记本电脑上的答题图标被打叉一半
shots.prompt_en: A laptop icon showing a quiz with a half red cross over it, next to a hand icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 只在电脑上做题，远远不够。
overlay: 培训要有实效，不能只刷题

shots.section_title: 培训要有实效，不能只刷题
shots.scene: 准入证书图标连着实验室门图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank certificate icon with an arrow pointing to a lab door icon. No people.
shots.narration: 考试是门槛，现场培训才是真本事。

shots.scene: 小研带阿杰在实验台旁动手演示
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student demonstrates at a lab bench while the young male student watches closely, both in lab coats and goggles.
shots.narration: 好的培训，一定要动手练。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，小研点头回答
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask a question; the female graduate student nods and answers.
shots.narration: 不懂就问，问到会为止。

shots.scene: 墙上的手动火灾报警按钮特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a red manual fire alarm call point on a white wall. No people.
shots.narration: 比如手动火灾报警按钮。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在报警按钮前，小研讲解
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in front of the red call point while the female graduate student explains, pointing at it.
shots.narration: 在哪、怎么按，要到现场亲眼看。

shots.section_title: 针对本场所、本物料培训
shots.scene: 实验室平面图上标出报警器、洗眼器、喷淋、灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A simple lab floor plan with icons marking an alarm, an eyewash, a safety shower and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 每个实验室的布局都不一样。
overlay: 针对本场所、本物料培训

shots.section_title: 针对本场所、本物料培训
shots.scene: 小研带阿杰走到洗眼器和喷淋旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks the young male student to an eyewash station and a safety shower.
shots.narration: 安全设备在哪、怎么拿到，走一遍。

shots.section_title: 针对本场所、本物料培训
shots.scene: 喇叭图标向四周发出声波
shots.prompt_en: A loudspeaker icon sending sound waves to several small person icons around it. No people.
shots.narration: 出事怎么通知全实验室，要事先约定。

shots.section_title: 针对本场所、本物料培训
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着试剂瓶看安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank bottle and reads a blank safety data sheet.
shots.narration: 用什么物料，就学它的应急方法。

shots.scene: 地上一滩水，旁边有黄色防滑警示牌
shots.prompt_en: A puddle of water on a lab floor with a yellow wet floor warning sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一类风险：溢洒和滴漏。

shots.scene: 人滑倒图标和插座进水图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a person slipping on water, and a power socket with water drops. No people.
shots.narration: 一滩水，就能让人滑倒，还会引发漏电。

shots.scene: 水滴图标加碱液瓶图标，中间是灼伤警示
shots.prompt_en: A water drop icon and a blank bottle with a corrosion pictogram, with a hot burn warning symbol between them. No people.
shots.narration: 水碰到碱液等化学品，可能造成灼伤。

shots.scene: 溶剂、胶水、油漆、粉尘四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a solvent bottle, a glue tube, a paint can and a cloud of dust. No people.
shots.narration: 第二类：溶剂、胶粘剂、涂料和粉尘。

shots.scene: 小研戴好防护，在通风柜里操作溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in lab coat, goggles and gloves works with a blank solvent bottle inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 看着不起眼，不管它照样伤人。

shots.scene: 噪声图标和温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a loud sound wave with an ear, and a thermometer with a high reading. No people.
shots.narration: 第三类：噪声和高温。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空压机旁戴上耳罩，在烘箱前戴隔热手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on ear muffs near a noisy machine, then wears heat-resistant gloves in front of a lab oven.
shots.narration: 有警示就听，按要求戴防护。

shots.scene: 运行中的设备指示灯突然熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument whose green running light suddenly goes dark, with a small question mark above it. No people.
shots.narration: 第四类：设备运行中突然停机。

shots.scene: 停机设备旁出现漏液和警示图标
shots.prompt_en: A stopped instrument icon with a dripping leak and a warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 会不会泄漏？会不会带来新风险？

shots.scene: 老周和老李对着设备讨论，手里拿着空白清单
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer discuss beside an instrument, holding a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 这些问题，事先就要想好对策。

shots.scene: 窗外暴雨雷电，楼内试剂柜
shots.prompt_en: Heavy rain and lightning outside a lab window, with a chemical cabinet inside. No people.
shots.narration: 第五类：恶劣天气。

shots.scene: 地面积水漫向试剂柜图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of rising floodwater approaching a storage cabinet, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 储存再好，天气也可能改变环境。

shots.section_title: 每项风险都写进书面计划
shots.scene: 五个风险图标各连到一张空白计划表
shots.prompt_en: Five small warning icons, each connected by a line to a blank plan sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 每一类风险，都要有书面控制计划。
overlay: 每项风险都写进书面计划

shots.section_title: 每项风险都写进书面计划
shots.scene: 老周把计划夹进文件夹，放在显眼处
shots.prompt_en: The older man places a blank plan into a binder on a shelf near the lab door.
shots.narration: 再加上危害沟通、培训和规范储存。

shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层图标，各有一个文件夹
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked building icons of decreasing size, each with a blank binder beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 学校、学院、实验室，都要有应急预案。

shots.scene: 王老师组织大家进行演练，众人有序行动
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads a drill; the female graduate student and the young male student move in an orderly way.
shots.narration: 预案要定期演练，练完再改进。

shots.scene: 溢洒处置包打开，里面有吸附材料和手套
shots.prompt_en: An open spill kit showing absorbent pads, gloves and a scoop. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室要备好溢洒处置包。

shots.scene: 小研戴好防护，用吸附垫围住少量溢洒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves surrounds a small spill on a bench with absorbent pads.
shots.narration: 少量溢洒，先防护，再围堵吸附。

shots.scene: 吸附后的材料装进废物袋，贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: Used absorbent pads placed into a waste bag with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 吸附物按危险废物收集，不倒下水道。

shots.scene: 大量溢洒图标旁是撤离箭头和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A large spill icon with an exit arrow and a telephone icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 量大或不明物，撤离并报告。

shots.scene: 楼里灯熄灭，设备屏幕变黑
shots.prompt_en: A lab room with lights off and instrument screens dark during a power cut. No people.
shots.narration: 停电、停水、停气，同样要应对。

shots.scene: 阿杰关闭设备开关，拔下插头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off an instrument and unplugs it during a power cut, with a flashlight in hand.
shots.narration: 先关掉设备和水、气阀门。

shots.scene: 老李复电前逐台检查设备，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks each instrument with a blank checklist before power returns.
shots.narration: 恢复前逐台检查，防止无人时自启。

shots.section_title: 恶劣天气和节假日前检查
shots.scene: 日历上标出假期，小研关窗检查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes a window in the lab; a calendar on the wall shows a holiday marked with a star.
shots.narration: 节假日和恶劣天气前，做一次检查。
overlay: 恶劣天气和节假日前检查

shots.section_title: 恶劣天气和节假日前检查
shots.scene: 门窗、排水、电源、气瓶四个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons with green checks: a closed window, a floor drain, a power switch off, a gas cylinder valve closed. No people.
shots.narration: 关门窗、查排水、断电源、关气瓶。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现储罐、通风和培训图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a storage tank, a fume hood and a hand with a check mark.
shots.narration: 储存之外要备应急，培训要动手。

shots.scene: 五个风险图标依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Five icons get green checks one by one: a puddle, a chemical bottle, an ear, a stopped machine, a storm cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒、化学、物理、停机、天气。

shots.scene: 文件夹、演练人群、溢洒包图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank binder, a group of small people walking in line, and a spill kit. No people.
shots.narration: 写成计划，定期演练，备好处置包。

shots.scene: 欣欣在应急物资柜旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside an emergency supply cabinet.
shots.narration: 有备无患，平安实验，下次见！
